summary: PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia Tbk filed Form 6-K to update disclosure of a proposed share buyback under OJK Regulation 29/2023. The buyback is valued up to IDR 4 trillion (approx. $250M USD at current rates), through the stock exchange or off-market, gradually or all at once, to be completed within 12 months from the GMS approval on June 8, 2026. The buyback shall not exceed 10% of issued and paid-up capital. Funding comes from internal cash. The board fully endorses the plan. Watch for GMS outcome, execution pace, and any impact on minority shareholders.
